label: Membership update
title: 🎉 Good News! Your ICSH Membership Now Lasts a Full 12 Months!
paragraphs: We're delighted to announce an exciting improvement to ICSH membership!
We're moving from a calendar-year membership system to a 12-month rolling membership, giving our members greater flexibility and even better value.
What does this mean for you?
Your ICSH membership will now be valid for a full 12 months from the date you join or renew, rather than expiring at the end of the calendar year.
For example, if you join or renew in October 2026, your membership will remain valid until October 2027 — there's no need to renew again in January!
And the best part? Annual membership is just £20.
This change also benefits existing members, whose membership validity will be based on their most recent joining or renewal date.
Every member can now enjoy a full year of ICSH benefits, regardless of when they join.
More flexibility. Better value. The same wonderful ICSH community.
